English Literature.question: ১) 'Man is by nature a political animal' stated by-
English Literature.exp: 'Man is by nature a political animal' (the Politics) said by Aristotle. Socrates said that 'An unexamined life is not worth living'. 'Necessity is the mother of invention' said by Plato. 'If God did not exist, it would be necessary to invent him' stated by Voltaire.

English Literature.question: ২) 'The Age of Shakespeare' is-
English Literature.exp:
The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into 4 main Periods.
These are -
- Elizabethan Period (1558-1603),
- Jacobean Period (1603-1625),
- Caroline Period (1625-1649), and
- Commonwealth Period (1649-1660).
'The Puritan Age' refers to (1620-1660).
The Age of Shakespeare is 1590-1616.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩) 'Portia' is an important character in the Shakespeare play.
English Literature.exp:
The Merchant of Venice is a comedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written about 1596–97.
The important characters of this play are - Antonio, Shylock, Portia (Heiress of Belmont), Bassanio, Jessica, etc.

Julius Caesar, a tragedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, produced in 1599–1600 and published in the First Folio of 1623 from a transcript of a promptbook.
The important characters of this play are - Julius Caesar, Mark Antony, Brutus, Quintus, Dardanius, Portia (Daughter of Cato and the wife of Brutus), Cato, Titinius, etc.

Source: Britannica and PlayShakespear.com

English Literature.question: ৪) An ancient story about gods and goddesses and their mysterious activities known as -
English Literature.exp: An ancient story about gods and goddesses and their mysterious activities known as Myth. In myths there may be human characters but the main characters must be supernatural beings.

English Literature.question: ৫) The Victorian Period is-
English Literature.exp: The Victorian Period is 1832-1901 (Nineteenth century).

English Literature.question: ৬) Who authored that statement 'Injustice anywhere is a threat to Justice everywhere'?
English Literature.exp: Famous speech of Martin Luther King Junior- 'Injustice anywhere is a threat to Justice everywhere', 'I have a dream that my four little children .......'

English Literature.question: ৭) Stanza is a -
English Literature.exp: Stanza is a division of poem. It is a smaller unit of the structure of a poem.

English Literature.question: ৮) Who said 'Men make their own history'?
English Literature.exp: Karl Marx is the father of socialism. Famous quotation of Karl Marx- 'Men make their own history', 'Religion is opium to the people'.

English Literature.question: ৯) Which one is the latest period of English literature?
English Literature.exp: The latest period of English literature is the Post-Modern period (1939-present), then the Modern Period (The Georgian Period)(1901-1939).

English Literature.question: ১০) 'Never to be found again' is the last line of-
English Literature.exp: To Daffodils is a poem written by Robert Herrick. The theme of this poem is 'Life is short, so live to the fullest'. Never to be found again' is the last line of 'To Daffodils'.

English Literature.question: ১১) 'Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought' taken from the writings of-
English Literature.exp: PB Shelley is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotation are 'The more we study, the more we discover our ignorance', 'Fear not the future, weep not for the past', 'Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought', 'If Winter comes can spring be far behind?', 'Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world'.

English Literature.question: ১২) 'Puffs, powders, patches, Bibles, billet-doux' is an example of-
English Literature.exp: Repetition of a consonant at the beginning of two or more words or stressed syllables is called Alleteration. 'Puffs, powders, patches, Bibles, billet-doux' is an example of Alleteration. Here 'p' has been repeated thrice and 'b' twice.

English Literature.question: ১৩) 'Fools rush in where angles fear to tread' stated by-
English Literature.exp: Alexander Pope is a Mock Heroic Poet. His famous quotation are 'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart', 'A little learning is a dangerous thing', 'To err is human, nto forgive is divine', 'An honest man is the noblest work of God', 'The proper study of mankind is man', 'Fools rush in where angles fear to tread', 'Hope springs eternal in the human breast'.

English Literature.question: ১৪) Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher is taken from the writings of-
English Literature.exp: William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotation are 'Child is the father of man', 'Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting', 'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her', 'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings', 'Poet is the breath and final speed of knowledge', 'Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher'.

English Literature.question: ১৫) The longest period of English literature is-
English Literature.exp: The longest period of English literature is The Anglo-Saxon Period. (450-1066 = 616 ages long.)

English Literature.question: ১৬) 'If God did not exist, it would be necessary to invent him' was state by-
English Literature.exp: Famous quotation of Voltaire- 'If God did not exist, it would be necessary to invent him', 'prejudice is the reason of fools', 'I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to death your right to say it'.

English Literature.question: ১৭) 'Goneril' is a important character in-
English Literature.exp: King Lear is a Tragedy of an arrogant king written by William Shakespeare. Goneril, Regan and Cordelia are daughters of the arrogant king.

English Literature.question: ১৮) Charity begins at home and Justice begins next door is taken from the novel of.........
English Literature.option3: গ) A tale of Two cities
English Literature.exp: Charles Dickens is the greatest novelist in the Victorian Period. His famous Novel is Great Expectations. Pip, Estella, Miss Havisham are the important character of Great Expectations. Famous quotation of great expectation- Charity begins at home and Justice begins next door.

English Literature.question: ১৯) 'Nine shoulders out of ten are born fools' was authored by-
English Literature.exp: G. B. Shaw is a greatest Dramatist of modern English literature. Important quotation of GB Shaw are 'It is our duty to live as long as we can', 'Nine shoulders out of ten are born fools', 'God is on the side of big battalions', 'Beware of false knowledge; it is more dangerous than ignorance'.

English Literature.question: ২০) 'Heathcliff' is the central character of-
English Literature.exp: Wuthering Heights is a famous novel written by Emily Bronte. Its important character are Heathcliff, Lockwood, Catherine Earnshaw etc.

English Literature.question: ২১) Who said that 'Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers'?
English Literature.exp: Alfred Tennyson is a famous Victorian poet. His famous quotation are 'Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers', 'Sorrows are the best educator', 'The old order changeth yielding place to new', 'Authority forgets a dying king', 'Who are wise in love, love most, say least', I will never rest from travels, I will drink life to the lees'.

English Literature.question: ২২) A fantasy is a/an -
English Literature.exp: A fantasy is an imaginary story.

English Literature.question: ২৩) 'Good fences make good neighbors' was written by-
English Literature.exp: Robert Frost is an American writer. Famous quotation of Robert Frost- 'Good fences make good neighbors', 'But I have promises to keep and miles to go before I sleep and miles to go before I sleep'. (Stopping by woods on a snowy evening).

English Literature.question: ২৪) 'Hector Malone' is a character of GB Shaw in -
English Literature.exp: Man and Superman is a play written by GB Shaw. It's important character are Hector Malone, Ann Whitefield, Mendoza, John Tanner.

English Literature.question: ২৫) 'Jealousy is the proof of love' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism. His famous quotation are 'They think too little talk too much', 'We first make our habits than habits make us', 'Jealousy is the proof of love'.

English Literature.question: ২৬) 'Mosca' is a important character in-
English Literature.exp: Volpone is a famous play written by Ben Jonson. It's important character are Volpone, Mosca, Celia, Bonario, Corvino.

English Literature.question: ২৭) The Renaissance Period is-
English Literature.exp: The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into 4 main Period. Such as Elizabethan Period (1558-1603), Jacobean Period (1603-1625), Caroline Period (1625-1649) and Commonwealth Period (1649-1660). 'The Puritan Age' is refers to (1620-1660). The Age of Shakespeare is 1590-1616.

English Literature.question: ২৮) 'Old wood best to burns, old wine to drink, old friends to trust and old author to read' said by-
English Literature.exp: Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose is Francis Bacon. Famous quotation of Bacon are 'Revenge is a kind of wild justice', 'Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects', 'Old wood best to burns, old wine to drink, old friends to trust and old author to read', 'Opportunity makes a thief', 'It is impossible to love and be wise', 'History makes man wise'.

English Literature.question: ২৯) A lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event is called-
English Literature.exp: A lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event is called Elegy.

English Literature.question: ৩০) 'Men's conscience is the Oracle of God' taken from the writings of-
English Literature.exp: Lord Byron is the rebel poet of English literature. His famous quotation are Men's conscience is the Oracle of God', 'Revenge is sweet especially to women', 'Man's love is of man's life a thing apart, it is women's whole existence'.

English Literature.question: ৩১) 'Willy Loman' is a character in-
English Literature.option4: ঘ) For Whom the Bell Tolls
English Literature.exp: Death of a Salesman is a famous play written by John Millington Synge. Willy Loman, Biff Loman, Howard Wagner, Linda Loman, Happy Loman, Charley.

English Literature.question: ৩২) 'Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: John Milton is a great Master of verse in the puritan period. He is an Epic poet in English literature. His famous quotation are 'Childhood shows the man as morning shows the day', 'It is better to reign in hell than to serve in heaven', 'Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity'.

English Literature.question: ৩৩) In which century was the Romantic Period?
English Literature.exp: The Romantic age is 1798-1832 which is belongs to Nineteenth century. The Victorian age is 1832-1900.

English Literature.question: ৩৪) 'Man is the maker of his own fate' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Christopher Marlowe is the father of English Drama or Tragedy. His famous quotations are 'Man is the maker of his own fate', 'Sweet Helen, make me immortal with a kiss'.

English Literature.question: ৩৫) 'All that glitters is not gold' quoted by William Shakespeare in-
English Literature.option3: গ) All's Well that Ends Well
English Literature.exp:
The Merchant of Venice is a famous comedy written by William Shakespeare.
Some famous quotation of this tragedy -
- 'It is a wise father that knows his own child',
- 'All that glitters is not gold',
- 'Love is blind',
- 'In sooth, I know not why I am so sad'.

English Literature.question: ৩৬) The age of 'the Commonwealth Period' is-
English Literature.exp: The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into 4 main Period. Such as Elizabethan Period (1558-1603), Jacobean Period (1603-1625), Caroline Period (1625-1649) and Commonwealth Period (1649-1660). 'The Puritan Age' is refers to (1620-1660). The Age of Shakespeare is 1590-1616.

English Literature.question: ৩৭) A figure of speech in which lifeless objects or ideas are given imaginary life is called-
English Literature.exp: A figure of speech in which lifeless objects or ideas are given imaginary life is called Personification. Examples- ''And Joy, whose hand is ever at his lips Bidding adieu'' here 'Joy' has been imagined as a living person.

English Literature.question: ৩৮) 'Brevity is the soul of wit' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Hamlet is a Tragedy written by William Shakespeare. Famous quotation of Hamlet- 'To be or not to be that is the question', 'Frailty, thy name is woman', Brevity is the soul of wit', Neither a borrower nor a lender be; For loan off loses both itself and friend'.

English Literature.question: ৩৯) 'Lilliputians' is a character in-
English Literature.exp: Gulliver's Travel is a fiction written by Jonathan Swift. Important character are Gulliver, Lilliputians, Houyhnhnms, Laputans, Blefuscudian etc.

English Literature.question: ৪০) An exaggerated statement or an extreme overstatement is called-
English Literature.exp: An exaggerated statement or an extreme overstatement is called Hyperbole. 'Ten thousand saw I at a glance' is an example of Hyperbole.

English Literature.question: ৪১) 'Full many a flower is born to blush unseen' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Thomas Gray is known as Graveyard poet. His famous quotation- Full many a flower is born to blush unseen, And waste its sweetness on the desert air', 'Where ignorance is bliss, it is folly to be wise', 'The paths of glory lead but to grave'.

English Literature.question: ৪২) 'Iago' is a famous character of William Shakespeare in -
English Literature.exp: Othello is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare. The Character of Othello are Othello, Desdemona, Brabantio, Iago, Cassio etc.

English Literature.question: ৪৩) 'Oppression makes the wise man mad' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Robert Browning is a Victorian poet. His famous quotation- 'Oppression makes the wise man mad', 'Ignorance is not innocence but sin', 'This I enter and thus I go!', 'So absolutely good is truth, Truth never hurts the taller'.

English Literature.question: ৪৪) 'Honesty is the best policy' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Benjamin Franklin is a USA philosopher. His famous quotation- 'Honesty is the best policy', 'Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise', 'Admiration is the daughter of ignorance', 'A penny saved is a penny earned', 'Eat to live not live to eat'.

English Literature.question: ৪৫) 'The Barren Period' of English literature is-
English Literature.exp: The Middle English Period is divided into 3 period. The Anglo Norman Period (1066-1340), The Age of Chaucer' (1340-1400) and The Dark or Barren Period (1400-1485/1500).

English Literature.question: ৪৬) The inversion in the order of words or phrases when repeated is called-
English Literature.exp: The inversion in the order of words or phrases when repeated is called Chiasmus. Examples- 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty', 'Fair is fool, and foul is fair'.

English Literature.question: ৪৭) 'Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of the fools' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: Famous quotation of Nepoleon- 'Give me a good mother; I will give you a good Nation', 'The career is open to the talents', England is a nation of shopkeepers', 'Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of the fools'.

English Literature.question: ৪৮) 'If you want to shine like the sun, first burn like it' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp: APJ Abdul Kalam was a former president of India. His famous quotation- ''If you want to shine like the sun, first burn like it', 'Dream is not that which you see while sleeping; It is something that will not let you sleep''.

English Literature.question: ৪৯) Who said, 'Popular opinion is the greatest lie'?
English Literature.exp: Thomas Carlyle was a Scottish philosopher. His famous quotation- 'Speech is great, silence is greater', 'Popular opinion is the greatest lie'.

English Literature.question: ৫০) 'Friday' is a character in-
English Literature.exp: Robinson Crusoe is a Novel written by Daniel Defoe. Main character of Robinson Crusoe: Robinson Crusoe, Friday, Xury.
